name: cyberchick-skills
description: CyberChickZ's Claude Code skills and hooks. Install only what you need.

plugins.name: context-rewrite
plugins.description: Find/replace the system prompt, system-reminders and conversation before each request is sent; applies to sessions started with claude --yrb.

plugins.name: ai-job-search
plugins.description: 全自动求职流水线：拉岗、预筛、选简历、派子代理填表、清邮箱、刷新看板。个人资料放本机 ~/.claude/cyberchick-skills/ai-job-search/。

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: 研究决策的 AI 盲审，防附和。

plugins.name: xiaohongshu
plugins.description: 小红书笔记、搜索、评论抓取和视频转录（依赖本机 Spider_XHS，路径用 XHS_HOME 指定）。

plugins.name: checkpoint
plugins.description: Memory checkpoint：把对话里的结论存进项目 memory、按需召回，上下文压缩后自动重载。

plugins.name: cyberchick-hooks
plugins.description: 个人 hooks：tool-ledger（记录输入和工具调用到 /tmp）、caffeinate（会话期间防休眠）

plugins.name: mac-notify
plugins.description: 有时效的待你操作（输密码、登录、授权）时设提醒：可延迟、可自动升级（通知→边缘闪光→晃屏），你回消息或点通知即取消。
